@gap{1 line fragmentary} @wDN{Ninurta}, you are the great wall of @wGN{Sumer}. You are respected because of your heroism.

Lord who renders true judgments, son of @wDN{Enlil}, linen-clad, god of the determining of fates, suited for lordship, king of the holy lustration rites, an expert in divination, you are indeed suited for the holy throne-dais!
